title: Breathlessness — Positions, Pacing and Breathing Control

hook.en: Breathlessness is frightening, and fear makes it worse. Learn the simple positions, pacing and breathing techniques that patients can use at home to take back control.
hook.ur: Saans ki tangi dara deti hai, aur dar usay barhata hai. Woh saadi positions, pacing aur saans ke tareeqe seekhein jo mareez ghar par istemal karke qaboo wapas pa sakte hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll teach pursed-lip breathing, breathing control, recovery positions, pacing and a hand-held fan, set a simple action plan and recognise when breathlessness is an emergency.
goal.ur: End tak aap pursed-lip breathing, breathing control, recovery positions, pacing aur hath ka pankha sikhayenge, saada action plan banayenge aur pehchanenge ke saans ki tangi kab emergency hai.

text.en: In long-term lung or heart disease, breathlessness often comes with **panic**: the person breathes faster, which makes the breathing harder and the fear worse. The aim of self-management is to **break that cycle** with a few tools: **positions** that ease breathing, **pursed-lip breathing**, **pacing** the day and **a fan** on the face. These do not cure the disease, but they help the person feel in control.
text.ur: Lambi phephron ya dil ki bimari mein saans ki tangi aksar **ghabrahat** ke saath aati hai: shakhs tez saans leta hai, jis se saans lena mushkil aur dar barh jata hai. Self-management ka maqsad **is chakkar ko torna** hai kuch auzaar se: saans aasan karne wali **positions**, **pursed-lip breathing**, din ki **pacing** aur chehre par **pankha**. Yeh bimari ka ilaj nahi, magar shakhs ko qaboo mein mehsoos karwate hain.

text.en: Think of breathlessness as **a car in a skid**. Slamming the brakes makes it worse. The calm response is to ease off, steer gently and let the car recover. Slow, relaxed breathing out and a supported position are the gentle steering that help the body regain control.
text.ur: Saans ki tangi ko **phislti hui gaari** samjhein. Achanak brake dabana halat bigarta hai. Pur-sukoon jawab yeh hai ke raftar kam karein, narmi se steer karein aur gaari ko sambhalne dein. Aahista, dheeli saans bahar nikalna aur sahara dene wali position woh narm steering hain jo jism ko qaboo wapas dilati hai.

steps.title: Find the triggers
steps.detail: Ask when breathlessness is worst (stairs, dressing, bathing, anxiety) and what the person fears. Check they have seen the doctor about worsening symptoms. || Triggers dhoondein

steps.title: Teach a recovery position
steps.detail: Leaning forward with the forearms on a table or the knees, shoulders relaxed, or sitting upright against a wall. These positions let the chest muscles work with less effort. || Recovery position sikhayein

steps.title: Teach pursed-lip breathing
steps.detail: Breathe in gently through the nose for two counts, then out slowly through lips as if blowing a candle for four counts. Do not force the breath out. || Pursed-lip breathing sikhayein

steps.title: Plan the day
steps.detail: Pace tasks, rest before you are exhausted, breathe out on the effort (for example when standing up or lifting) and use a hand-held fan on the cheeks. Write a simple plan for a bad day. || Din ka plan banayein

question.en: Which breathing pattern is taught for breathlessness?
question.ur: Saans ki tangi ke liye kaun sa saans ka pattern sikhaya jata hai?

text.en: Holding the breath for as long as possible
text.ur: Jitni der ho sake saans rokna

text.en: Fast, deep breaths through the mouth

feedback.ur: Yeh saans ki tangi aur dar barhata hai.

text.en: In through the nose, then out slowly through pursed lips, longer than the breath in
text.ur: Naak se andar, phir pursed hontoon se aahista bahar, andar se lambi

feedback.en: Yes — slow breathing out keeps the airways open and calms the pattern.
feedback.ur: Haan — aahista saans bahar nikalna saans ki naliyon ko khula rakhta hai aur pattern ko pur-sukoon karta hai.

title.ur: Ghabrahat ki saans ya qaboo ki saans?

rows.en: Longer than the breath in, through pursed lips
rows.ur: Andar se lambi, pursed hontoon se
Zyada kharab aur dara dene wali
Mehnat aur dar kam karti hai

text.en: **Lean, lips, slow.** Lean forward with support, breathe out through pursed lips, and slow down. Add a fan on the face and the person usually feels better within minutes.
text.ur: **Jhukein, hont, aahista.** Sahare ke saath aage jhukein, pursed hontoon se saans bahar nikalein, aur raftar kam karein. Chehre par pankha lagayein to shakhs aam taur par chand minute mein behtar mehsoos karta hai.

text.en: **Telling the patient to "just relax and breathe deeply".** Deep breathing in is not the aim and can make air trapping worse. Teach slow breathing out, a supported position and a clear plan, and explain that breathlessness is uncomfortable but not itself harmful in a stable condition.
text.ur: **Mareez ko "bas relax karo aur gehri saans lo" kehna.** Gehri saans andar lena maqsad nahi aur air trapping bigaad sakta hai. Aahista saans bahar nikalna, sahare wali position aur saaf plan sikhayein, aur samjhayein ke stable halat mein saans ki tangi takleef deh hai magar khud nuqsandeh nahi.

question.en: Which position helps a breathless patient?
question.ur: Saans ki tangi wale mareez ki madad kaun si position karti hai?

text.en: Leaning forward with the forearms supported on a table or knees
text.ur: Aage jhukna, bazu mez ya ghutnon par tike hue

feedback.en: Yes — it supports the shoulders and lets the chest muscles work.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh kandhon ko sahara deti hai aur seene ke muscles ko kaam karne deti hai.
Yeh aksar saans ki tangi barhata hai.

text.ur: Bazu oopar kar ke khara hona

feedback.ur: Yeh kandhon ko thaka deta hai.

question.ur: Saans ki tangi emergency kab hoti hai?

text.ur: Seedhiyan chadhne ke baad halki saans ki tangi

feedback.en: That can be usual for the person.
feedback.ur: Yeh shakhs ke liye aam ho sakti hai.

text.en: Severe breathlessness at rest with blue lips, chest pain, confusion or drowsiness
text.ur: Aaram mein shadeed saans ki tangi, neelay honth, seene ka dard, uljhan ya neend

feedback.en: Yes — these need urgent medical help.
feedback.ur: Haan — in ko foran medical madad chahiye.

text.en: Breathlessness that settles with rest and pacing
text.ur: Aaram aur pacing se thamne wali saans ki tangi

feedback.ur: Yeh aam pattern se milti hai.

text.en: **Make a one-page plan.** Write the person's three best tools (their position, their breathing and the fan), the signs that mean call the doctor and the signs that mean call the ambulance. Practise them together while the person is calm, not only during an attack.
text.ur: **Ek safha ka plan banayein.** Shakhs ke teen behtareen auzaar (position, saans aur pankha), woh nishaniyan jin par doctor ko call karna hai aur woh jin par ambulance bulani hai likhein. Inhein shakhs ke pur-sukoon hone par saath practise karein, sirf daure ke dauran nahi.

question.en: Why does breathing out slowly through pursed lips help?
question.ur: Pursed hontoon se aahista saans bahar nikalna madadgar kyun hai?

answer.en: It creates a small resistance that keeps the airways open for longer, so less air is trapped in the lungs, and the slow rhythm calms the breathing pattern. Many people also feel less anxious because they have a technique to use.
answer.ur: Yeh ek chhoti rukawat paida karta hai jo saans ki naliyon ko zyada der khula rakhti hai, is liye phephron mein kam hawa phansti hai, aur aahista rhythm saans ka pattern pur-sukoon karta hai. Bohat se log kam ghabrahat bhi mehsoos karte hain kyunke unke paas istemal karne ka tareeqa hota hai.

beats.patient: A 66-year-old man with COPD becomes breathless and anxious climbing the stairs. He stops, gasps and says "I cannot breathe". His oxygen level is normal for him and he has no chest pain.
beats.assessment: The picture is exertional breathlessness with anxiety, with no emergency signs.
beats.treatment: Help him to lean on the rail, teach pursed-lip breathing and a fan, then discuss pacing the stairs.
beats.reassess: After practice, he recovers in a minute or two and climbs the stairs by pacing steps with a rest on the landing.

text.en: **Call for urgent help** for severe breathlessness at rest, blue lips, chest pain, confusion, drowsiness, fainting, coughing blood or a sudden onset with calf pain. Do not teach self-management as a replacement for medical review when symptoms are getting worse. Follow the doctor's advice on inhalers and oxygen.
text.ur: **Foran madad bulayein** aaram mein shadeed saans ki tangi, neelay honth, seene ka dard, uljhan, neend, behoshi, khoon ki khansi ya achanak shuruaat pindli ke dard ke saath. Barhti alamaat mein self-management ko medical review ka mutabadil na sikhayein. Inhaler aur oxygen par doctor ka mashwara maanein.

summary.en: Breathlessness often brings panic that makes it worse; self-management breaks the cycle with positions, pursed-lip breathing, pacing and a fan.
summary.ur: Saans ki tangi aksar ghabrahat laati hai jo usay bigarti hai; self-management positions, pursed-lip breathing, pacing aur pankhe se is chakkar ko torta hai.

summary.en: Breathe in gently through the nose and out slowly through pursed lips, lean forward with support, and breathe out on effort.
summary.ur: Naak se aahista andar aur pursed hontoon se aahista bahar saans lein, sahare ke saath aage jhukein, aur mehnat par saans bahar nikalein.

summary.en: Write a simple action plan and teach the signs of an emergency.
summary.ur: Saada action plan likhein aur emergency ki nishaniyan sikhayein.

back.en: Breathing in through the nose and slowly out through pursed lips.
back.ur: Naak se andar aur pursed hontoon se aahista bahar saans lena.

back.en: Leaning forward with the forearms supported on a table or knees.
back.ur: Aage jhukna, bazu mez ya ghutnon par tike hue.

back.en: Air on the face can reduce the sensation of breathlessness.
back.ur: Chehre par hawa saans ki tangi ka ehsaas kam kar sakti hai.

front.ur: Saans ki tangi emergency kab hai?

back.en: At rest with blue lips, chest pain, confusion or drowsiness.
back.ur: Aaram mein neelay honth, seene ka dard, uljhan ya neend ke saath.

note.ur: Balgham mehfooz tareeqe se saaf karna.
Mehnat aur saans ki tangi naapna.
